paragraphs: In Chullin 107a: “Rav Ashi instituted in Hutzal.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rav Assi.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Chullin 107a paragraph has Rav Ashi instituting in Hutzal. Hyman’s scribal-error assertion and proposed Rav Assi remain his editorial claims; the digital reading does not establish a correction history or license an identity merge. No legal detail is imported.
